text:
sam: quick dump from tonight's run: tried a routing heuristic that disables speculative fast-path for inputs with context_len>600 and runs q4_hybrid speculative for short contexts. baseline model: titan-lite-13b-q4h. overall token throughput +1.8x for short-doc cohort, no speedup for long-docs (as expected).

leah: interesting. did the routing eliminate the ROUGE-L drop you saw earlier?

sam: yes — for long-doc cohort (n=400) delta is ~0.0 ROUGE-L. short-doc cohort (n=1200) shows a small ROUGE-L -0.9 but bootstrap p~0.12 so not significant. aggregated holdout (full) shows negligible net regression.

omar: what exact routing rule? and how is context_len measured (tokens vs chars)?

sam: rule: if context_tokens>600 -> route to deterministic (no-spec) fp16; else -> spec_q4h. measuring via our tokenizer (redwood_tokenizer.v2). implemented as per-request policy in runtime config: `spec_route(context_len_tokens, threshold=600)`.

leah: perf numbers and config? paste command please.

sam: command:
```
./eval_harness \
  --model titan-lite-13b-q4h \
  --speculative_enable=true \
  --spec_routing_threshold=600 \
  --spec_policy=route_to_fp16_on_long \
  --kv_prefetch=true \
  --tasks=summarization \
  --holdout=route-holdout-v1 \
  --batch=12
```

omar: what about verifier latency spikes? earlier we saw verifier causing p95 outliers when fallback happens.

sam: added metrics: spec_accept_rate_by_bin and verifier_extra_time_ms. For short-docs accept_rate~78%, verifier_extra_time p95~45ms. For long-docs we route away so no verifier overhead. Overall p95 improved by ~120ms vs baseline fp16-only.

leah: any signs of increased truncation or hallucination in short-docs?

sam: manual spot-check 30 examples: 2 cases mild truncation (predictor output short tail), 1 case minor hallucinated fact. Flagged examples in /experiments/route-2026-03-21/triage.json.

omar: could be due to quantization interaction. Did you try a hybrid mitigator: increase early_abort for short-docs or use beamlet fallback for predictor when context_len between 200-600?

sam: tried early_abort=0.06 for short-docs -> accept_rate down ~6 pts, speedup drops to ~1.5x but ROUGE-L closer to baseline. beamlet fallback (beam=3) increased verifier load but improved quality slightly. Tradeoffs are tunable.

ci-bot: job 7340002001 finished - artifacts: /artifacts/7340002001/metrics.json - logs: https://ci/internal/arty/7340002001

leah: next steps: (1) run paired bootstrap on short-doc cohort for ROUGE/BERTScore with n=1000, (2) param sweep early_abort [0.02,0.06,0.1] + beamlet 1/3, (3) add per-request routing telemetry to runtime to capture misroutes (cases where route->fp16 but spec would have improved latency without quality loss).

omar: also log spec_accept_rate_by_pred_len (length of predicted fast-path) and accept_rate_by_last_token_entropy. Might reveal predictor bias.

sam: done. I'll queue the sweep and push branch `exp/routing-short-only-734000` with harness v2.6. Will post results in followup. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
